title: Brain/Aurora — Observabilidade de LLM
description: Custo, latência, erros e repair loops por turno de conversa. Fonte: agent_logs (eventos por etapa, ligados por trace_id — ver migration 106/107).

panels.title: Custo por 100 mensagens (USD)
panels.description: cost_usd fica NULL até a tabela de preços em api/services/model_pricing.py ser confirmada com o preço real da DeepSeek — até lá este painel mostra vazio, de propósito, em vez de um número inventado.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SUM(cost_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS "custo_por_100_msgs" FROM agent_logs WHERE agent_type = 'conversation.commit' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS turnos FROM agent_logs WHERE agent_type = 'conversation.commit' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS taxa_erro_pct FROM agent_logs WHERE agent_type LIKE 'conversation.%' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN (output->>'handoff_required')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS taxa_handoff_pct FROM agent_logs WHERE agent_type = 'conversation.commit' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, '5m') AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95 FROM agent_logs WHERE agent_type = 'conversation.decide_llm_call' AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, '1h') AS time, COALESCE(model_used, 'desconhecido') AS metric, SUM(COALESCE(token_input, 0) + COALESCE(token_output, 0)) AS value FROM agent_logs WHERE agent_type IN ('conversation.decide_llm_call', 'conversation.repair_call') AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, model_used ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Turnos com repair loop
panels.description: Turnos com mais de uma chamada de decide/LLM (conversation.decide_llm_call + conversation.repair_call) para o mesmo trace_id.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS turnos_com_repair FROM (SELECT trace_id FROM agent_logs WHERE agent_type IN ('conversation.decide_llm_call', 'conversation.repair_call') AND trace_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY trace_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t

panels.title: Tokens de cache (hit vs miss)
panels.description: Preenchido só depois de confirmar o campo real de cache tokens na API da DeepSeek (Fase 1 condicional) -- até lá, sem dado, de propósito.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM((metadata->>'prompt_cache_hit_tokens')::numeric) / NULLIF(SUM((metadata->>'prompt_cache_hit_tokens')::numeric) + SUM((metadata->>'prompt_cache_miss_tokens')::numeric), 0) AS cache_hit_pct FROM agent_logs WHERE agent_type = 'conversation.decide_llm_call' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Qualidade média da resposta
panels.description: Reservado -- score de qualidade em tráfego real é Fase 4, deliberadamente adiada. Sem dado até essa fase existir.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(quality_score) AS quality_media FROM agent_logs WHERE quality_score IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT lead_id, SUM(cost_usd) AS custo_total_usd, COUNT(*) AS mensagens FROM agent_logs WHERE agent_type = 'conversation.commit' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY lead_id ORDER BY custo_total_usd DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20
SELECT created_at, lead_id, agent_type AS etapa, error_msg, trace_id FROM agent_logs WHERE status = 'error' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
